title: [Job-32154] Data Product Manager (Hybrid)
description: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions. With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy. We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day. We are looking for a Data Product Manager to join our team in the UK. This role sits at the intersection of business, product, data and engineering, helping turn complex business needs into clear, actionable product direction. Your Mission As a Data Product Manager, you will own and evolve data-focused products, working closely with business stakeholders, Application Engineers, Data Engineers and Data Scientists. A key part of your role will be navigating complex business environments, understanding different stakeholder needs and turning complex requirements into a clear and prioritized product roadmap that can be delivered over the coming months. You will also bridge the gap between business and technology, going deeper into functional and non-functional requirements and helping translate them into clear technical requirements and user stories for engineering teams. What You’ll Do Own, define and continuously evolve the product roadmap for data products and initiatives. Understand complex business problems and translate them into clear product requirements and priorities. Deep dive into functional and non-functional requirements and help translate them into technical requirements for engineering teams. Partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Application Engineers. Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical dependencies and product objectives. Work with engineering teams to ensure requirements are clear, feasible and aligned with the overall product strategy. Use data and SQL to independently investigate and validate information when needed. Manage different stakeholder expectations and create clarity in complex business environments. Work within Agile/Scrum teams to support the continuous delivery and evolution of the product. What We’re Looking For Proven experience as a Product Manager working with data products, BI/analytics products, data platforms or data infrastructure. Strong experience owning and managing a product roadmap. Ability to navigate complex business environments and turn multiple or ambiguous requirements into clear priorities and deliverable plans. Strong understanding of data ecosystems and application development. Ability to translate business needs into functional, non-functional and technical requirements. Hands-on SQL knowledge, with the ability to independently validate and explore data. Experience working directly with Application Engineers, Data Engineers and/or Data Scientists. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Nice to Have Experience with ML/AI model deployment or MLOps. Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI. Working Model This is a UK-based hybrid position, with an expectation of being in the office 2–3 days per week. #Midsenior #Li-MG04 Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions. title: Senior Manager, Marketing Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><div> <p><strong>THE WORK:</strong></p> <p>We are growing, and so is the breadth and depth of our marketing programs, with AI at the core of how we scale. We are looking for a highly motivated, diligent, and data-driven Senior Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Operations team. Reporting into the Director, Marketing Operations and Demand Generation, this role will serve as the analytical backbone of our growth marketing engine — leading the measurement, visualization, and insights infrastructure that drives smarter investment decisions and executive-level confidence in our marketing performance.</p> <p>In this role, you will own analytics and reporting across all growth marketing functions, from campaign performance to pipeline attribution. You'll partner closely with Growth Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and other cross-functional teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the full funnel. You'll also be a practitioner and champion of AI-powered tools — using them to automate workflows, accelerate insight generation, and elevate the sophistication of our marketing measurement at scale.</p> <p>You'll use data to continuously improve reporting efficiency, forecast accuracy, and budget allocation decisions, helping ensure our marketing analytics engine drives measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own analytics and end-to-end measurement across all growth marketing functions, ensuring consistent and actionable reporting from spend to revenue.</li> <li>Lead the visualization and reporting infrastructure across growth marketing, translating complex data into clear, compelling dashboards and narratives for AI-powered tools and predictive modeling to surface proactive insights, identify trends, and support faster, more confident decision-making across the marketing team.</li> <li>Empower experimentation MCI and other platforms, to build reporting that connect spend to pipeline and revenue.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to automate reporting and analytics workflows using AI to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.</li> <li>Ensure data quality and integrity across CRM and marketing systems.</li> </ul> </div> <div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BRING: </strong></p> </div> <div> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or a related field</li> <li>Deep expertise in growth marketing measurement methodologies across the funnel</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM and marketing data pipelines</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts as applied to marketing analytics, such as predictive modelling, anomaly detection, or automated insights</li> <li>Strong proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or similar)</li> <li>Experience with attribution modeling, media mix modeling, and/or incrementality title: 2027 Software Engineer Intern
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support global command and control (C2) missions. We create joint, time-sensitive, multi-domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our technology enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of endpoints across the globe. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for time-sensitive decisions, effectively transforming the way that allied militaries close kill chains and enable mission autonomy.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the software solutions that are deployed to customers and key stakeholders.</li> <li>Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next steps.</li> <li>Work on real, meaningful projects and learn from experienced professionals along the way.</li> <li>Support feature development and software solutions that are deployed to customers, and lead complex, cross-cutting technical efforts from concept to deployment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or any related field</li> <li>Must be graduating from a bachelor’s or master’s degree in 2028</li> <li>Must be returning to University at the end of the internship to continue studies for at least one academic year.</li> <li>Ability to complete an in-person internship in our London office.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with algorithms, data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools</li> <li>Proficiency in a variety of programming languages such as Python, C, Java, or Python.</li> <li>A desire to work on software and applications that have real-world impact</li> <li>Have a bias for action. If you see a problem, you want to solve and fix it</li> <li>Be naturally curious about the technologies and tools you use</li> <li>Be able to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. </span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p> </p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.</p> </div> <div class="RichText column2"> <p class="detailElios">To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:</p> <ul> <li> <p class="detailElios"><strong>No Financial Requests: </strong>Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. title: Software Quality Operations Specialist - Germany/Spain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>The Software Quality Operations (SWQOps) team is at the heart of enabling safe and successful scale-up into new international markets and incubating mission-critical, high-impact workflows. Our mission is to build an adaptable and scalable operation, increasingly powered by AI, to deliver the crucial insights necessary to confidently deploy and grow Waymo's autonomous vehicle service.</p> <p><strong>Why This Team is Essential to Waymo's Success: </strong></p> <p>Waymo is undergoing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities (targeting ~20 new cities by EOY 2026, including international expansion to London and Tokyo) and launching new vehicle platforms. SWQOps, especially our Technical Specialists, plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently. We are on the front lines of: </p> <ul> <li>International RO & New Market Readiness: Concerted effort to update triage policy, standing Voice of Customer in new countries. Through meticulous triage of driving events, issue discovery, and continuous field monitoring, SWQOps provides early warnings and critical insights to Product and Data Science partners.</li> <li>Supporting the development of a single, automated, end-to-end machine learning flywheel for the entire Waymo Driver. A successful flywheel will be the core engine for scaling our technology, enabling faster international expansion, quicker remediation of driving issues, and a significant reduction in the engineering effort required to maintain and improve the driver.</li> <li>Driving Engineering Velocity: By handling the vital work of performance evaluation, issue deep-dives, and data set curation, SWQOps collaborates heavily and allows Waymo's Engineering, SysEng, Simulation, and Data Science teams to focus on their core tasks of developing and improving the Waymo Driver. </li> <li>Workflow Incubation & Development: Incubating high-impact workflows and ensuring readiness for automation and long-term operational excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Engineering to design, test, and deploy cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (Gen-AI) models and tools to drive step-change improvements in issue discovery & detection, triage efficiency, and quality assurance. Provides technical requirements to Engineering for tooling that supports new market workflows (e.g., localization of ML/Gen-AI models, new data pipelines).</li> <li>Leverage AI-powered insights and traditional triage signals to proactively identify emerging on-road issue trends, new risk scenarios, and edge cases. Develop and refine data-driven strategies for issue discovery and monitoring, enhanced by ML model outputs</li> <li>Serve as the key link between AI/ML development and operational execution. Define and document new policies, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that integrate AI tools and insights into daily vendor workflows.</li> <li>Design and implement robust quality control processes for both human and AI-generated outputs. Designs and validates new triage policies, SOPs, and quality control processes specifically for Continental European driving rules and data signals (Germany and Spain).</li> <li>Act as the Subject Matter Expert for technical policies and guidelines in the new market. Consult with local/international stakeholders to ensure seamless adoption of technical policies.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership and consultation to stakeholders to enhance our workflows and quality. You'll be at the forefront of identifying and escalating issues with our tools, providing technical requirements to engineering, and driving user testing to support the development and deployment of new tooling features.<br><br></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS/BA degree in a technical or analytical field, or 5+ years of relevant work experience in Autonomous Vehicles (AV), Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS), automotive systems engineering, robotics, or complex technical software operations.</li> <li>Active, valid driver's license with extensive personal on-road driving experience and a thorough understanding of driving rules, roadway design, and regulations in European metropolitan areas, specifically under the German (StVO) and/or Spanish (DGT) traffic frameworks.</li> <li>Increased competency in supporting all phases of the machine learning development lifecycle, from data preparation and training to validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with ML testing and validation, including dataset quality assurance, bias detection, edge-case scenario testing, and performance evaluation using statistical metrics.</li> <li>Ability to quickly learn and implement new concepts, analyze data logs using 3D visualization platforms, and utilize proprietary tools. Strong understanding of driving rules and regulations.</li> <li>A proven ability to work in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining good judgment and navigating technical ambiguity.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with a wide range of individuals in a diverse and dynamic work environment</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated strong execution with ability to drive outcomes in new environments, from early-stage to maturity  </li> <li>Strong communication skills in German </li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with international and/or offshore vendor teams to drive global process standardization and quality</li> <li>Analytic skills and basic SQL querying</li> <li>Competency in LLM / transformer models, and / or ML for robotics domain experience</li> <li>A greater focus on using your subject matter expertise for results analysis and direct customer consultation in the development of new and improved solutions</li> <li>Self-motivated with basic skills in task planning and time management</li> <li>Experience with project management or program management in a global, distributed environment</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level.  Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements. </span></p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£97,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£105,000 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Enablement Lead
description: About Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we're growing fast. In-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one place: requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. More than 500 companies use Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage. The role We're hiring an Enablement Lead to own how customers learn Wordsmith, and how they become confident, self-sufficient users of it. You'll own onboarding, training and enablement end to end: Legal AI fundamentals, product and feature overviews, self-paced certifications, and re-enablement for customers who've stalled. You'll teach both ends of the customer organisation: the lawyers and business users in Wordsmith every day, and the champions and admins who support their colleagues. This is an enablement role, not a delivery or commercial one. You won't own implementation, technical support, renewals, account growth or a sales quota. Your focus is capability: do customers know how to use Wordsmith well, and can they keep learning without us? What you'll do Own customer onboarding. Design and run the journey that takes a newly implemented customer to a confident, capable team, and keep improving it. Teach Legal AI fundamentals. Build the curriculum that helps legal teams understand what AI agents do well, where judgement stays with them, and how to work alongside the technology. Run live training. Lead onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and feature deep dives for lawyers, business users and admins of every technical confidence level. Build the self-paced academy. Create online certifications and learning paths so customers can train new joiners and refresh skills on their own. Maintain the enablement library. Keep guides and product overviews accurate as Wordsmith ships, and retire what's out of date. Re-enable struggling customers. Diagnose why adoption has stalled and run focused programmes that get teams back to self-sufficiency. Train the champions. Equip customer champions and admins to teach their own colleagues, so capability compounds inside each account. Shape in-app help. Work with Product to build guidance, walkthroughs and prompts into Wordsmith itself. Measure whether learning worked. Define what a trained, self-sufficient customer looks like, track it, and use the evidence to change what we teach. Partner across customer teams. Work with Transformation, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product so enablement reflects real implementations, questions and product changes. What we're looking for 3–5 years in customer enablement, training, onboarding, customer education, implementation or a similar customer-facing role where teaching was central. You design learning, not just deliver it. You can turn a complex product into a curriculum with a clear sequence and outcomes. Confidence in front of a room, in person and on video, with senior lawyers as readily as with day-to-day users. Experience building self-paced content (courses, certifications, guides, video) and a view on what makes people finish it. A clear, warm communication style that makes unfamiliar ideas easy to grasp without oversimplifying them. Strong organisation: you can run several programmes, sessions and content deadlines at once without losing detail. Comfort with data. You can read product-usage information, spot where learning hasn't landed and act on it. Curiosity about AI and legal technology. You don't need a legal background, but you'll want to learn the product and our customers' work deeply. A strong learning mindset: you welcome feedback, apply coaching and want to grow quickly. How we work We're an in-person team in Edinburgh, so expect to work from the office or visit customers by default. We set a high bar, move quickly and give people real ownership. There won't always be a playbook, so you'll bring curiosity, structure and persistence. You'll work closely with the VP of Transformation and with Customer Success, Account Management and Product. Each customer team has a clear remit: Transformation leads implementation Support Engineering resolves technical issues Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability Why join Wordsmith Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding inside larger organisations. Because Legal AI is new to almost everyone who buys it, teaching it well is one of the highest-leverage things we can do. You'll join early enough to define what customer enablement at Wordsmith is: the curriculum, the certifications, and the standard for what a confident user looks like. You'll work directly with ambitious legal teams, learn the product deeply and develop fast in a high-performing team. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Supply Chain Lead
description: Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows. We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 🛠️ Procurement Team @ Bloom & Wild Group You’ll be joining the engine room of Bloom & Wild’s fastest-growing categories. While we are known for our flowers, our Procurement team provides the operational and supply chain foundation for our non-horticultural range. From fresh-baked treats and luxury hamper components to home, lifestyle, and the essential packaging that delivers the "wow" moment. Our team is divided into two clear pillars: Strategic Procurement and Stock Planning. As the Supply Chain Lead, you will report to the Head of Procurement & Inventory, acting as the architect of our operational procurement function and building the scalable systems we need to grow. We are a team that "cares wildly" about impact. Working closely with partners across the business, we ensure the infrastructure is in place to support their vision. Our focus is on delivering perfect availability, optimising inventory health, and enabling rapid range expansion through robust operational processes. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a function from the ground up and see your work directly fuel our success as we scale. ⚙️ What you'll be doing: Build & Scale the Function You’ll be the architect of our non-horticultural stock planning strategy. This is a "build from scratch" opportunity where you will set the vision for how we scale, demonstrating the ability to turn rapid business growth into a sophisticated, high-performing operational machine Master Stock Availability: You will lead your team to ensure optimal stock levels across all sites, balancing high availability with the need to minimise waste and holding costs. Navigating multi-site space constraints, you’ll work in lockstep with our Warehouse teams and Strategic Procurement Managers to ensure our supply is as efficient as it is reliable. Develop & Automate: Build scalable, custom, automated supply chain and inventory tools and develop AI workflows to eliminate manual data entry and calculation tasks. You will lead the development of agile, spreadsheet-based solutions while mapping the transition to long-term, robust systems. Process & KPI Leadership Develop standardised processes and frameworks, leading weekly KPI reviews to shift the function from reactive problem-solving to proactive inventory and risk management. You’ll define what "success" looks like for the department. Team Transformation & Development Provide oversight, coaching, and mentorship to a team of stock planners, transitioning them from manual execution to analytical decision-making. You will build internal succession and resilience, ensuring the team is equipped to handle increasing complexity. Strategic Growth & Inventory Control De-risk the launch of new ranges by ensuring our operational infrastructure is mature enough to handle increased SKU counts. You'll collaborate with the commercial team to ensure right-size inventory levels to protect availability, de-risk peak periods, and release trapped cash, while developing third-party relationships (charities/discounters) to manage excess stock. Operational Execution: Support with planning and execution when needed to ensure continuity (especially when issues occur or in peak times) 3PW Performance Management: Measure and manage performance of our 3PW partner against agreed SLA terms Supplier Performance: Build internal operational performance reporting and supplier tiering, put in place initiatives to improve operational supplier performance. ✅ You’ll love this role if you… Experience in a procurement, purchasing, supply chain or supply planning role, with experience leading a team Have a proven track record in supply chain scalability - You have experience managing exponential growth of SKUs by using technology and automation to absorb increasing complexity Are tech-savvy and systems-oriented - You have strong capabilities in building automated tools using G-suite and other platforms, and have been leveraging AI to increase your impact in this area Are a strong leader and mentor - You excel at coaching team members, fostering a performance culture centered around accountability and ownership of results and know how to manage your stakeholders effectively. Have a continuous improvement mindset - You are adept at identifying system limitations and establishing continuous feedback loops with your team to resolve and automate them further Are proactive and hands-on - You are willing to be a direct contributor to enable scale , rolling up your sleeves to understand operational tasks to a high standard and covering gaps during peak periods or illness Are commercially and data-driven You are motivated by protecting margins, eliminating P&L leakage driven by manual errors, and right sizing inventory levels to optimise working capital and cash flow. These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you. 🏡 Belonging @ Bloom & Wild We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers. We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team. Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working. 🧭 Our ways of working We really believe in the power of connection. For us that looks different depending on the team you work in. Some of our teams work together in person every day, whereas others may connect in person every quarter. We also believe in flexibility that supports you, the work you do, and your team. How much you work from home and from our office depends on a balance of those needs, and you’ll agree this with your manager. Whether it’s through a shared project, a learning and development opportunity, or an afterwork social - we trust our teams to make the right decisions (for them and us) about where and how they work each day. We’re big on collaboration, empathy, knowledge sharing and growth, and our values drive our priorities every day: Lead change for good: we have the guts to try new things and step up to do what matters most Think deeply, act swiftly : we make sure there’s thoughtful rationale behind our approach and always act swiftly to implement ideas Care wildly: we pour care and creativity into everything we do and pay attention to the things that make a difference Stay open, be curious: we’re open about what we’re doing and why, and we welcome challenges from each other 🌟 Work that works for you To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day. Our perks and benefits include: ⏰ Flexible working & work from abroad 🌴 25 days holiday + your birthday + flexible bank holidays, & option to buy additional holiday each year 💛 1 Volunteering day each year 🐣 Enhanced family leave and a workplace nursery scheme 🌱 A flexible training framework for every stage of your career 💐 Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions! 📈 Share in our success with a choice to take equity options from day 1 🏋 ClassPass membership: monthly credits to spend on fitness classes, yoga and much more! For more information on our perks & bens, please see www.bloomandwild.com/careers 🫱‍🫲 Getting hired We know that job searching can be daunting, and we want to do everything we can to ensure that your experience with us is a good one. Interviewing is a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’re the right move for you. We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help you flourish throughout your application process with us, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience. #Bloom&Wild Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application. About the role We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You will report to our Senior Manager of Data & AI Products, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will: Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination). Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance. Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature. Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure. Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas. Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols. Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services. Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy. Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails. To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more! What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure. A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs. Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources. Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning. Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka. Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based). AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment. Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two. The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement. Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers. You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements. You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering. This role is not a good fit for you if: You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy. You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team. You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will: Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised. Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it. Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary. Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis. 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options. We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background. Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)</li> <li>Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong><a href="http://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a></strong> is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. For more than 50 years, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.</p> <p>CRA's <strong><a href="https://ecp.crai.com/">European Competition practice</a></strong> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. Summary Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in the UK. This team ensures that users can safely browse the web through Menlo's secure cloud — protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorised web applications. The services this team builds are core to Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which puts you at the centre of one of the most active problems in enterprise security right now: how organisations gain visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI usage without blocking it entirely. The team applies AI in how it builds as well — code assistants, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-supported log and incident analysis — so you will be using these tools alongside defending against their misuse. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers. End-to-end ownership of assigned features, from design through production operation and iteration. Success Metrics / KPIs: (drafted for hiring manager review and adjustment) Service availability and latency for owned components meet or exceed team SLOs. Features delivered on committed roadmap dates, with quality measured by post-release defect and rollback rates. Automated test coverage maintained or improved on owned code paths. Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates. Mean time to detect and resolve production issues in owned services. What You'll Do Design, develop, and own new features and services in the Threat Protection and ShadowAI product area, contributing directly to Menlo's technical roadmap. Build highly available, scalable distributed systems and APIs, including multithreaded and asynchronous applications, with performance and security considered from the start. Build and refine the detection and policy capabilities that give customers visibility into generative AI and unsanctioned web application usage in their environments. Participate in building, deploying, and operating the Menlo Security platform in production, using dashboards, error reporting, metrics, and AI-assisted log and trace analysis to identify and resolve defects quickly. Use AI code assistants and AI-assisted test generation as part of your normal workflow to move faster, while applying your own judgement on correctness, security, and maintainability before anything ships. Partner with product, security, operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align on requirements, tradeoffs, and schedules. Write unit and automated tests, conduct code and design reviews for peers, and evaluate emerging technologies that could improve our products. Functional Competencies Required: 3-5 years of professional software development experience with one or more of NodeJS, Go, or Python. 3-5 years of hands-on experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS. Working experience with Linux and standard development tooling such as git. Degree in Computer Science or a related field (BE, BTech, or Masters), or equivalent practical experience. Practical fluency with AI coding and debugging assistants, including sound judgement about when to rely on LLM output and when to verify it independently. Self-directed approach to problem solving, with the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems and technologies with limited guidance. Preferred / Nice to Have: Experience building large-scale web applications and REST APIs. Strong grounding in complex data structures and database technologies. Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes. Experience with cloud infrastructure as code tooling such as Terraform. Familiarity with the Tornado web application framework and test automation. Track record of adapting and improving engineering practices such as test-driven development, continuous delivery, agile ceremonies, automation, and maintainable, testable code. Interest in or exposure to security, threat detection, or AI governance and safety. MSGL-I4 Follow us on LinkedIn ! Why Menlo? Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership , Straight Talk , United Impact , Elevated Talent , and Customer-Compelled . We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here. title: Technical Delivery Manager
description: Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words. We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. What you'll do You’ll join Cytix’s Software Engineering department as our Technical Delivery Manager, helping turn our product roadmap into predictable, high-quality releases. Following our Series A funding, we’re expanding our engineering team. We’re looking for someone with a technical background who can bring structure to delivery, keep teams aligned and remove the obstacles that slow engineers down. Reporting to the Co-Founder / CTO, you’ll work with a distributed team of up to ten engineers across Manchester, the wider UK and overseas. This is an individual contributor role with responsibility for coordinating delivery and improving how the team works. What you'll need Own day-to-day delivery of the agreed roadmap, working with the CTO and engineers to turn priorities into realistic plans and clear milestones. Work with engineers to break down work, assess capacity and understand estimates, making trade-offs and delivery risks visible early. Use your technical understanding to identify dependencies, challenge assumptions constructively and help resolve delivery blockers. Coordinate engineering and QA so testing and release readiness are built into delivery plans. Keep stakeholders informed about progress, risks and decisions needed, with clear reporting that supports action. Act as the delivery point of contact for Customer Success, ensuring customer feedback and requests enter a clear prioritisation process. Keep delivery aligned with company priorities, making the impact of changes to scope or urgency explicit. Establish practical ways of working that support a growing engineering team without adding unnecessary administration. Improve delivery using evidence from completed work, release quality and team feedback. Success in this role means engineers have clear priorities, blockers are addressed quickly, and stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered and when. You’ll work on Cytix’s core product, with our Manchester City Centre office as your base. If you have a Computer Science degree, with 2-3 years experience in a technical environment and / or have worked in a software focused role and looking to pivot into a TDM please reach out. We're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you. Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. The postholder is one of four Engineering Managers in a Product, Design and Engineering department of around 40 to 50 people, which is growing and maturing quickly. Act as the chief unblocker for the team across tooling, infrastructure, testing and process, and own the team's infrastructure-as-code estate. Identify the genuine constraints on throughput, including code review latency, slow or flaky tests, handoffs, approval gates and unreliable environments. Own testing standards and the consistency of quality across the team, including the definition of “tested”, the criteria that gate a release, and the management of coverage and test flakiness. Quality should not vary according to who wrote the code. Establish paved roads and automated guardrails that teams adopt on merit, and sequence the change so that it strengthens delivery. Work with the technical leads to maintain an accurate and current picture of technical debt, quality and process constraints. Translate it into risks and opportunities the Product Manager can prioritise, so that the balance between product output and technical excellence is a deliberate decision. Lead the team's adoption of AI-assisted development. Set the standards for where and how AI is used, ensure AI-generated code is understood and accountable to a named engineer, guard against data, licensing and security risk, and maintain an evidence-based view of its effect on the team. Help establish consistent engineering practice across TrustFlight with the other Engineering Managers. No shared approach to levelling, calibration, feedback and hiring yet exists, and building one is part of this role, so that an engineer's experience does not depend on which manager they report to. Required Qualifications & Experience: At least three years' experience as a dedicated people manager of software engineers, including senior engineers and, ideally, technical leads. Current, practical familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and automated testing, covering Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent, containerised deployment and a major cloud platform, sufficient to own the estate, set standards and review the work. A track record of raising and holding a quality bar across a team: testing strategy, review standards, and the discipline to keep them consistent as the team and the codebase change. Demonstrable experience of improving how a team works, supported by evidence of the resulting difference. Direct experience of performance management, including at least one case of successfully improving, or fairly exiting, an underperformer. Desirable Skills & Experience Practical experience of agentic development setups, using tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, introduced at team or organisation level along with the governance around them. Experience building or operating auditable agent orchestration systems. A strong advantage, though not a requirement. A track record of putting AI workflows into real use, and of helping ship AI features in production applications. An understanding that this field is changing quickly, with the adaptability to keep pace and the credibility to bring a team along on that journey. Experience leading, or contributing materially to, a technology-stack consolidation across multiple teams. Experience raising standards across a heterogeneous or inherited technology estate without mandating uniformity. Experience in a regulated, safety-critical or externally audited software environment, such as aviation, medical, defence or financial services. Valuable, though not a requirement. AI & Digital Competency TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation. Every role is expected to actively engage with AI tools and digital ways of working to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation. Tier 3 — AI Builder Develops and integrates AI-powered solutions Builds, fine-tunes, or integrates AI/ML models and pipelines. Establishes evaluation frameworks for AI systems. Ensures responsible AI practices (fairness, transparency, data governance). Contributes to TrustFlight’s AI strategy. Role-Specific AI & Digital Skills: Set and maintain the team's standards for AI-assisted development, covering which tools are approved, where they may and may not be used, and how their output is reviewed. Ensure AI-generated code entering the codebase is understood and accountable to a named engineer, and that review capacity scales with the volume AI produces. Apply AI to strengthen testing and documentation, ensuring that AI-written tests validate the requirement and do not simply confirm the behaviour of the implementation. Establish guardrails against the specific risks of AI-assisted engineering: leakage of customer or regulated data into model context, licensing contamination, and plausible but incorrect code in safety-relevant paths. AI Development & Growth Complete TrustFlight's AI fluency onboarding within the first 30 days. Dedicate time each month to evaluating emerging AI development tooling and agentic workflows, and pilot promising tools in a controlled way. Share findings with the Engineering Manager group and the wider engineering team, including negative results. Contribute to TrustFlight's engineering-wide standards for AI-assisted development, and to the evidence base available to customers and auditors. Competencies & Behaviours: People Leadership — Raises the bar with every hire and promotion; coaches deliberately and develops leaders as well as engineers; creates the conditions for people to do their best work. Fairness and Consistency — Applies the same bar and the same care to everyone; makes reasoning visible; is trusted by engineers and by peers in calibration. Systems Thinking — Treats delivery problems as problems with the system rather than with the people; identifies the constraint before asking for more effort; takes obstacles off other people's desks and measures success by the team's output. Technical Judgement — Sufficient depth to ask the right question, weigh a trade-off, and defer to the technical leads when appropriate. High Standards in a Safety Domain — Holds a consistent quality bar and does not allow defects to pass down the line; recognises that operators' safety cases depend on this software. Accountable for the team’s on-call practice being sustainable and fairly shared. Special Conditions: Right to work in the UK. title: VP of Sales, EMEA

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line This is the seat where EMEA goes from early traction to a real engine: you own the number, you build the team, and you stay close enough to the deals to feel every one of them. What that looks like day to day Our GTM team is growing quickly. In London we already have pods across Enterprise Sales, Commercial Sales, Customer Success, BDR and Solutions Engineering, with a mix of internally promoted and externally hired first-line and segment leaders in place. You own the EMEA revenue number, including new business and the bulk of net retention across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise. You lead the EMEA sales org directly, setting the bar on hiring, performance, coaching and territory design. You partner with in-region CS, SE, BDR and expansion account management to make the full regional motion work. This is not a role you can do from behind a forecast. You'll be in the deals, running exec-level conversations with CTOs, CIOs and CISOs, inspecting and coaching pipeline personally, and carrying the deals that need you. You'll also drive operational excellence across pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, recruiting, enablement, fiscal planning and territory design. Our leaders are close to the product, close to customers, and close to cross-functional peers. You'll work closely with our founders, COO, CMO, VP Finance, RevOps and Product, and build trust with Engineering, Marketing, Finance and company leadership. What you hear in region should influence the roadmap, and you'll contribute to company-wide planning and exec discussions, helping shape our global growth trajectory. We want a real point of view on AI in GTM. How your team prospects, researches, qualifies, forecasts and closes should look different because of it. You also set the cultural tone in London: a high performance bar, and a culture people want to be part of. Who you are You're based in or around London, and you're up for travelling across EMEA and occasionally to the US. You've built an EMEA revenue engine from roughly $XXM to $XXXM at a high-growth B2B software company, and you have the appetite and resilience to take us from early traction to sustained scale in a Series B environment. You've built and scaled sales teams across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise, and you know how the motion, hiring bar and cadence differ across each. You're hands-on. You still get into deals, run discovery, coach live calls and hold a point of view on the product. You're not two layers removed from the customer. You understand technical sales and have a track record selling to CTOs, CIOs and CISOs. You have a real point of view on leveraging AI in GTM, grounded in things you've actually rolled out rather than things you've read about. You keep a high performance bar while building a culture aligned with our values. We want both, and candidates who can only do one are not a fit. You're also an exceptional recruiter who attracts and retains A-players, and people follow you. You build trust extensively across Engineering, Product and company leadership, and you're operationally excellent, with a bias for clarity, measurement and predictable execution. Bonus points if you have experience scaling footprint into other European markets such as France, DACH and the Nordics. VP of EMEA Sales experience at a high-growth SaaS company scaling from $XXM to $XXXM+ is a plus, as is senior regional leadership at a $10B+ B2B software company with material revenue responsibility. We'd also love experience selling to engineering and SRE buyers in the reliability, observability, monitoring or DevOps space, early channel and alliances go-to-market experience, and the ability to lead cross-cultural teams across Europe. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control. Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants. The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. What is Optimisation in Flex? The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns. The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies. The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute. Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine. 🚀 What you’ll own: The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably. This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. title: Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice
description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more. As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs? What You'll Do Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases. Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience. Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams. Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve. Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve. Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market. Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities. Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities. Who You Are You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance. You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics. You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights. You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly. You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives. You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time. You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors. You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify. Where You'll Be This role is based in London We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
